text: すぐに　しまから　でていけ！

patterns.name: 〜ろ (command)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending (ろ on some verbs, an え-sound on others) is a blunt order. でていく becomes でていけ = 'get out!'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb adds the idea of moving away from here. でて いく is 'go out and away', so でていけ = 'get out of here'.
